name: flaggems_lcm_
description: In-place element-wise least common multiple: self.lcm_(other). Mutates and returns self.
reference:
import torch


def run(self, other):
    self.lcm_(other)
    return self


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    self_shape = tuple(ctx["self__shape"])
    self_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["self__dtype"])
    other_shape = tuple(ctx["other__shape"])
    other_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["other__dtype"])
    self_t = torch.randint(1, 100, self_shape, dtype=self_dtype, device=device)
    other_t = torch.randint(1, 100, other_shape, dtype=other_dtype, device=device)
    return {"self": self_t, "other": other_t}
